critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1041 lines - well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly consider splitting into routers/services (auth, teams, players, matches, fixtures, inventory, bookings, uploads).

/api/fixtures/generate auto-creates a tournament with name='FSC' season=current_year category=payload.category. If two consecutive calls use different categories within the same year, the second will reuse the first tournament (looked up by name+season only, ignoring category) so its category attribute is misleading. Consider keying lookup by (name, season, category) or always creating a per-fixture tournament.

_round_robin_pairs: when len==1 after appending None, the first round may produce no matches but rounds list still contains that empty round, increasing `rounds` count. Mitigated by the >=2 check, but still worth a guard.
FixtureGenerateIn does not validate days_between_rounds >= 1 (allowing 0 or negative would stack all rounds on the same date).
Fair play column in Match model defaults to 0 but standings code does `int(m.get('home_fair_play') or 0)` - good defensive coding, retained.
AdminLayout sidebar exposes 'Generar Fixture' link, but no protected route exists -> dead link in production until App.js is fixed.

rca of the issue: RCA: The two frontend bugs share the same root cause - main agent created the new components/pages (AdminFixtureGenerator.jsx + matchday filter logic in Fixture.jsx) but did not wire them into the visible UI. (1) AdminFixtureGenerator: the import was added to App.js (line 32) and AdminLayout.jsx nav got the link (line 21), but the corresponding <Route> element is missing inside the <Route path='/admin' element={<AdminLayout/>}> block (lines 76-87). Reproduction: login as admin, navigate to /admin/generador-fixture -> blank page with React Router console warning. (2) Fixture matchday chips: state (`matchdayFilter`) and computation (`matchdays`) and filter logic (line 29) all exist, but the JSX rendering the chips is absent (only category chips render around lines 48-66). Mitigation: small, focused additions to App.js (1 line) and Fixture.jsx (5-6 line block). No backend change required.
